scope: Official and developer descriptions of adjacent game mechanics; proposed adaptations are design hypotheses, not player-validated results.

sources.mechanic: Exploration restores resources while the supply of unexplored terrain is finite.
sources.adaptation: Visible finite incense nodes with alternative uses; preserve readable fixed maps.
A few deterministic elite rooms and boss phases with full outcome previews.

sources.mechanic: Throwing a spear temporarily removes lunge until it is retrieved; some upgrades require health sacrifice.
sources.adaptation: Ability deployment should change available options and create explicit opportunity costs.

sources.mechanic: Handcrafted rooms focus on movement, weapon orientation and logic.
sources.adaptation: Room-level reversible experimentation that restores all local rewards and costs atomically.

sources.mechanic: Manipulating visible rule objects changes interactions.
sources.adaptation: A small stable vocabulary of weight, light, solidity and identity shared by abilities and mechanisms.

sources.mechanic: Equipment changes the adventurer's usable ability and spatial solution.
sources.adaptation: Different monkey forms should change object interactions, not merely unlock a differently colored obstacle.

sources.mechanic: An interconnected world and collectible manual pages with hints and secrets.
sources.adaptation: A clue journal that connects newly understood rules with explicitly marked earlier locations.

sources.mechanic: Synergistic builds and dangerous or safe paths with different rewards and costs.
sources.adaptation: Visible branch rewards and build commitments without importing card draws or randomized maps.

sources.mechanic: Handcrafted puzzles develop a system through new ideas rather than filler.
sources.adaptation: Give every floor a distinct intended discovery, with introduction, variation and combination across each chapter.

sources.mechanic: Rewind supports searching paths through monsters and treasure.
sources.adaptation: Decision-level undo and comparing selected route plans.

sources.mechanic: Fixed nonrandom towers with undo/redo, status comparison and route memos.
sources.adaptation: Persist manual save slots, compare snapshots and record routes without making repeated walking consume all undo history.

sources.mechanic: Contextual tool learning and opportunities to experiment.
sources.adaptation: Short safe situations that demonstrate why a tool matters before presenting the full rules.

sources.mechanic: Stealth, precision and cooperation support high-stakes mission objectives.
sources.adaptation: Optional rescue, bypass and preservation objectives so killing every guardian is not the only rewarding policy.
